description: Mark Thompson responds to Sarah Kim's outreach. Initiates a direct meeting — coffee or shop walkthrough — to understand her situation and explore whether she would serve as a guest instructor for the Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline program. Small social expense (~$15 coffee). Primary exchange is professional time and relationship capital in both directions.

expected_outcomes.from_perspective: Mark gains a potential industry partner and guest instructor with real floor experience, which strengthens the board presentation and gives the program practitioner credibility. Relationship trust with Sarah Kim likely increases.
expected_outcomes.to_perspective: Sarah Kim receives direct, responsive engagement from an educator who may be building a retraining or pipeline program relevant to her own career transition considerations.
